dct_title_s: Vegetation Features - Points (Digital Map Database of China)
dct_creator_sm: National Bureau of Surveying and Mapping (NBSM)
dct_description_sm: This coverage contains vegetation features throughout China, represented by points. Vegetation polygons less than 1.5 square millimeters on the source map are represented as points. These features include mangrove forests, economically exploited forests (bamboo, coffee, etc.), shrub and grassland areas. Not all vegetation types found in China are represented in this coverage.
dct_publisher_sm: National Bureau of Surveying and Mapping (NBSM)
